title: Talking to the user: print and input

scaffold.reason: First 10 lessons of the course: everything by hand

check_questions.q: Predict: x = input('x? ') with 3, then print(x + x) and print(int(x) + int(x))
Spot the bug: price = input(...) (2.5), qty = int(input(...)) (3), print(price * qty)
check_questions.note: Diagnosis and float fix right first try. Said output was '2.5 2.5 2.5' (spaces). Wrote f'{price * qty}:.2' (spec outside braces, no f); fixed to :.2f inside braces after one prompt. Watch format-spec placement in the task.
First try: abc right, but thought end='!' carried to the next print and that y started a new line. Got the variant (cat-dog-fish / bird) right after re-explaining. Watch end= in task req 6.
